verdict.rationale: Cake confirms a distinct 'My Cake Portal' for stakeholders separate from the admin cap-table view, and free-plan docs list 'stakeholder portals' as included, implying employees see their own equity info. However, there is no explicit evidence describing what the portal shows (grant details, vesting progress bars, strike price) or any 'what-if' scenario/outcome value modeling for individual stakeholders. missing for 10: documentation of vesting progress visualization, strike price display, and equity outcome/scenario modeling shown to employees.
